Here is a collection of spatial computing libraries and color palette systems engineered to address the distinct topological dynamics of island environments.

      <h3>ArchipelagoEngine</h3>
      <p>Implements specialized K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) spatial weights matrices (W) tailored to prevent geographic data isolation among fragmented islands.</p>

  <!-- Card 2: roroph -->
  <div class="software-card">

    <div class="software-info">
      <h3>roroph</h3>
      <p>A machine-readable spatial data network capturing provincial links, shipping coordinates, and travel times across the primary avenues of the Philippine Nautical Highway System.</p>
      <a href="https://cran.r-project.org/package=roroph" class="btn software-btn" target="_blank">View on CRAN</a>
    </div>
